quests.title: Viridian Forest: the Honey tree (weekday Bug Pokémon)
Route 3: the Scyther chase (Charmander starters) / Bug Catcher Kenji (others)

wild.method: Bug-Catching Contest: Set 1: Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays
notes: During the Bug-Catching Contest, the wild Pokémon come from the contest sets listed below, not from the park's normal table.

acquisitions.conditions: Use one Honey on the shining Honey tree on Sunday. Repeatable with more Honey; the DS clock determines the weekday.
Charmander starter only. Talk to Bug Catcher Kenji to reveal the Scyther on the ledge, then challenge it. One encounter; catching, defeating or fleeing removes it.

steps.text: Level up holding Metal Coat during the day (4:00–19:59)
